title: Complete Guide to Reliable Lockscreen Adhan Across Android Brands
subtitle: Many Android phone makers enforce aggressive battery-saving managers that pause alarms or block lockscreen overlays when the screen is off. Follow your phone brand's steps below once to keep Adhan ringing reliably.

checklistSection.eyebrow: Three Essentials on Every Android Phone
checklistSection.title: The 3 permissions behind 100% reliable Adhan
checklistSection.subtitle: Zad Al-Muslim checks these automatically inside Settings → Fix Permissions:

items.title: Alarms & Reminders (Exact Alarms)
items.desc: Lets AlarmClock wake the phone at the exact second of prayer even during Android Doze sleep mode.

items.title: Unrestricted Battery / No Restrictions
items.desc: Prevents the OEM battery optimizer from killing background scheduling overnight before Fajr.

items.title: Show on Lock Screen & Display Pop-ups
items.desc: Allows the native lockscreen Adhan interface, Stop button, and post-Adhan Duaa to appear immediately over the lock screen.

brandsSection.title: Select your phone manufacturer
brandsSection.subtitle: Verified menu paths across the most widely used Android skins:

brands.summary: Honor & Huawei enable automatic app management by default, which terminates background alarms unless switched to manual.
steps: Open phone Settings → Apps → App Launch.
Find 'Zad Al-Muslim' and toggle OFF 'Manage automatically'.
Manually turn ON all three switches: Auto-launch, Secondary launch, and Run in background.
Inside the app: Settings → Fix Permissions, ensure Lockscreen display and Appear on top are allowed.
brands.note: Avoid enabling Ultra Power Saving overnight as it pauses third-party media services.

brands.summary: Xiaomi requires toggling two extra permissions inside 'Other permissions' so lockscreen overlays can open automatically.
steps: Long-press the Zad Al-Muslim icon → App Info.
Enable 'Autostart' (or Background autostart).
Open 'Battery saver' and select 'No restrictions'.
Open 'Other permissions' and enable both 'Show on Lock screen' and 'Display pop-up windows while running in the background'.

brands.summary: Samsung OneUI may automatically move apps into 'Sleeping apps' after a few days without manual opening.
steps: Open App Info → Battery → select 'Unrestricted'.
Go to Device Care → Battery → Background usage limits and verify Zad Al-Muslim is NOT in Sleeping or Deep Sleeping apps.
Add it to 'Never auto sleeping apps' if available.
Ensure Notifications and 'Alarms & reminders' remain enabled.

brands.summary: ColorOS relies on allowing background activity and auto-launch inside App Battery Settings.
steps: Open App Info → Battery usage.
Enable 'Allow foreground activity' and 'Allow background activity'.
Enable 'Allow auto-launch' if visible on the same screen.
Verify Alarms & reminders and Lockscreen display are allowed.

brands.summary: Vivo devices use a dedicated high background power usage toggle to preserve alarm apps.
steps: Open App Info → Battery → select 'High background power usage' or 'Unrestricted'.
Go to Settings → Apps & Permissions → Permission Management → Autostart and enable Zad Al-Muslim.
Enable Floating window and Lockscreen display under Permissions.

brands.summary: OxygenOS is close to stock Android but applies sleep standby optimization overnight unless exempted.
steps: Long-press the app icon → App Info → Battery usage.
Enable 'Allow background activity' and 'Allow auto-launch'.
Open phone Settings → Battery → More settings → disable 'Sleep standby optimization' if alarms delay overnight.

brands.summary: Stock Android has minimal OEM interference—simply grant Unrestricted battery and Full-screen alarm permissions.
steps: Open App Info → App battery usage.
Select 'Unrestricted' (or toggle ON Allow background usage).
Open 'Alarms & reminders' and confirm it is enabled.
On Android 14+, ensure Full-screen notifications and regular Notifications are allowed.

verifySection.title: Verify Adhan on your phone in 10 seconds
steps: Open Zad Al-Muslim → Settings → Test Adhan / Lockscreen Check.
Tap 'Test Adhan in 5 seconds' and immediately lock your screen with the power button.
Wait 5 seconds: the screen wakes cleanly with the lockscreen UI and full Adhan audio.
